description: Pinnacle West is an investor-owned electric utility holding company based in Phoenix, Arizona with consolidated assets of approximately $30 billion, deriving essentially all of its revenues and earnings from its principal subsidiary, APS, whose affiliates have provided energy and energy-related products to people and businesses throughout Arizona since 1886. APS is Arizona's largest and longest-serving electric company and generates safe, affordable electricity in 11 of Arizona's 15 counties, and Pinnacle West's other active subsidiaries are El Dorado and PNW Power. Its reportable business segment is its regulated electricity segment, which consists of traditional regulated retail and wholesale electricity businesses, primarily electric service to Native Load customers, and related activities, and includes electricity generation, transmission and distribution conducted primarily through its wholly-owned subsidiary APS.
